mapper.sql: uc.id, uc.user_id, uc.coupon_id, uc.status, uc.order_number, uc.used_time, uc.gmt_created, uc.gmt_modified, c.name AS coupon_name, c.type AS coupon_type, c.threshold, c.amount AS coupon_amount, c.discount AS coupon_discount, c.max_discount AS coupon_max_discount, c.end_time AS coupon_end_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user_coupon` (id, user_id, coupon_id, status, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `user_coupon` uc LEFT JOIN `coupon` c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user_coupon` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId}

SELECT FROM `user_coupon` uc JOIN `coupon` c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'UNUSED' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOW() BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time AND c.threshold <= #{amount} ORDER BY c.threshold DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `user_coupon` SET status = 'USED', order_number = #{orderNumber}, used_time = NOW(), gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'UNUSED'
UPDATE `user_coupon` SET status = 'UNUSED', order_number = NULL, used_time = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'USED'
